description: Department of Forest Conservation - Order Declare the State lands as Alagalla Reserved forest from 7th August 2024.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters. It contains notifications under the Forest Conservation Ordinance, declaring specific state lands as a Reserved Forest and placing them under the control of the Conservator General of Forests. While it mentions the Minister's name and title, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to make legal declarations, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content is about establishing legal status for land under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
